column2: A cylinder has come down here.
The lid of the cylinder is slowly unscrewing. Strike now, before it opens.
The crew is assembling the fighting machines.
The Martians' pit. Its soldiers are the crews of the fighting machines.
The people here are kept as livestock. Nothing is grown or dug.
The machines and minds of an older, colder world.
A blood-red alien weed chokes the fields and rivers.
The Martians have lost control of this province. If they don't retake it, it will return to its rightful owner.
In 60 days this province returns to its rightful owner, unless the Martians retake it first.
